_comment: Exploration levers (prompt 08 §3, docs/EXPLORATION.md). insight: the first free look at each of these tables in a battle restores mp MP; the first Insight of all unlocks the Codex page named by codex. satchel_pulse_hp: below this HP share the satchel button pulses when an item would help. drops: what each guardian leaves when beaten (item name -> how many). coins: the purse a new run starts with, and what each guardian leaves (spent at the Hearth's stall, data/hearth/stall.csv).
